script: exec 2>/dev/null; echo E >&2; echo O

name: exec-2-null-next-line
script:
exec 2>/dev/null
echo E >&2
echo O

name: exec-1-file
script: t=$(mktemp); exec 3>&1 1>"$t"; echo hidden; exec 1>&3 3>&-; echo shown; cat "$t"; rm -f "$t"

name: exec-3-file-and-close
script: t=$(mktemp); exec 3>"$t"; echo a >&3; echo b >&3; exec 3>&-; { echo c >&3; } 2>/dev/null; echo "st=$?"; cat "$t"; rm -f "$t"

name: exec-2-to-1
script: t=$(mktemp); exec 3>&1 1>"$t" 2>&1; echo O; echo E >&2; exec 1>&3 2>&3 3>&-; cat "$t"; rm -f "$t"

name: exec-2-restore-from-3
script: exec 3>&2 2>/dev/null; echo E1 >&2; exec 2>&3 3>&-; echo E2 >&2; echo O

name: exec-in-function
script: f() { exec 2>/dev/null; }; f; echo E >&2; echo O

name: exec-in-subshell
script: ( exec 2>/dev/null; echo E1 >&2 ); echo E2 >&2

name: external-command-after-exec
script: exec 2>/dev/null; /bin/sh -c 'echo E >&2; echo O'
